intro: Enterprise Product Architect operating at the intersection of People, Process, and Technology. I have a proven track record of transforming complex ERP requirements into modular, scalable platform capabilities within highly regulated GxP environments.

I lead the evolution of enterprise software by bridging SAP BTP ecosystem architectures, including CAP, UI5, and Cloud Integration, with agentic AI workflows, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and tool-enabled reasoning.

Grounded in the principle that those who implement are best equipped to architect, I combine full-stack technical depth in the SAP BTP ecosystem (CAP, UI5, Cloud Integration) with clear, enthusiastic team leadership. My focus is breaking down massive, ambiguous challenges into actionable architectural vision, refining delivery pipelines, and keeping cross-functional teams aligned from concept to production release.
